text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And so, we've reached the opening of the
Solefall Faire.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We've got a haunted house just waiting to
scare ya on the third floor!
Won't you stop
by?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I would be remiss not to mention that
it's actually a haunted castle! A fortress
molded by the hands of a legion of
hardworking and
precious Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, demonic propagandist! Time to
switch!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey, yo! ☆ Just leave it to us!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it isn't two of my fellow divine
generals! Thank you, I shall leave
this task
in your most capable of hands!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Reception for Windy's Demonic Castle is
right over here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan has finished with propaganda duty!
How fare our guest
numbers?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well met! Um, we've had a long line that
only just cleared now! I'd say
the numbers
are good!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to be expected of a castle as
illustrious as ours!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I believe my ability to draw in the crowds
to be the weakest among the divine
generals. Surely more guests will arrive
shortly with those
two outside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Our efforts are being repaid in spades,
for the shrieks echoing from the halls of
Windy's Demonic Castle barely cease
throughout the entirety of the Solefall
Faire.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Though perhaps they're less cries of
fear, and more the joyous howls of those
appreciating a simple scare and the sheer
cuteness of our
queen.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (And soon...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Break time! First, to the auditorium to
watch everyone's shows. Then, hit up as
many exhibits as possible, then check out
the food stalls
after that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've got a lot on my plate,
but 'tis a plate
stacked with the sweetest of
morsels!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But wait,
if this is the performance that's
next on the schedule, then that means
there's only about two hours left until
the closing ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then it'll all be... over?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(As I make the rounds, the sun sets before
I know it. All that remains
now is cleanup
and the after-party.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(A blazing bonfire surrounded by Umas
engaged in pair dancing or
snacking on
leftovers from the food stalls...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Perhaps on some other day, their very
visages would be enough to
send me into a
frenzy, but I—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oww! D-did something bite me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'd recognize that silhouette
anywhere! Wait just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Digital! Wait... lemme guess. You also
felt some mysterious bite,
gave chase to
the shadow and ended up here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Also," you say... Does that mean it
happened to all of you? Doto and Helios
included... Why,
the whole entire legion is
here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! You all make for such easy
prey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I believe I've told you time and again to
not get sloppy! You might
find yourself
victim to the most devilish of—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (And at that very moment...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(As if to elevate the Demon Queen's words
of wisdom into the very
sky itself, the
brightest of lights shines across the
rooftop.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazin'! I just knew this would be
the place to see them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, so you baited us all into coming
up here for this?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Now this is what I'd call a lit reward...
literally! Our liege is the GOAT!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: H-HMPH! Don't get it twisted!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, Windy's Demonic Castle DID turn
out to be a big, huge, massive success! As
your illustrious Demon Queen, some
thanks are in
order, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Windy... Thank you so much! This year's
Solefall Faire was just so
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's a little sad to see it end,
after all we've
been through...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, it is a little sad for sure.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(But there's a happiness in my heart to
match... no, eclipse it. After
all...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I've managed to break through that hole
in my filter entirely,
breathing the same air
as all of you.)
